datasets.title: Iraq - Injury and death during the ISIS occupation of Mosul and its liberation
datasets.description: This is the minimal underlying dataset for a forthcoming manuscript presenting results from a cross-sectional survey aimed at measuring deaths, injuries, and kidnapping in Mosul households during the 29 months of ISIS control and the 8 months of Iraqi military action during the liberation.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/injury-and-death-during-the-isis-occupation-of-mosul-and-its-liberation]

lineage.description: Cross-sectional household survey conducted in Mosul to measure mortality, morbidity, and kidnapping outcomes during the ISIS occupation (29 months) and subsequent Iraqi military liberation operations (8 months). Survey data were compiled into a minimal dataset for epidemiological analysis of conflict-related health impacts.
